configurations.name: backend-extractive
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src" ND_LLM_PROVIDER=extractive ND_RAG_WARM_ON_STARTUP=true ND_FEEDBACK_DIR=/tmp/nd-feedback-demo exec uv run --no-sync uvicorn neural_debugger.backend.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: backend-gemini
runtimeArgs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src" ND_LLM_PROVIDER=gemini ND_LLM_MODEL=gemini-3.1-flash-lite ND_LLM_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=7 ND_LLM_MAX_REQUESTS=40 ND_RAG_WARM_ON_STARTUP=true ND_FEEDBACK_DIR=/tmp/nd-feedback-demo exec uv run --no-sync uvicorn neural_debugger.backend.main:app --port 8000
